arabic text: MAI KAISE UTHU AQA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: HOW SHOULD I GET UP MY MASTER, I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: MAI KAISE UTHU AQA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: HAZRAT ABBAS (A.S) IS CALLING OUT TO IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.),\nHOW SHOULD I GET UP O MASTER, I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: AQA YE GULAAMI KA SILA KAISA DIYA HAI\nKIS PYAAR SE SAR AAPNE ZAANU PE RAKHA HAI\nUTHKAR SALAAM KARTA MERE HAATH NAHI HAI,
english translation text: I HAVE BEEN YOUR SERVANT ALL MY LIFE,\nHOW LOVINGLY YOU HAVE KEPT MY HEAD O`N YOUR LAP,\nI WOULD HAVE STOOD UP AND GREETED YOU BUT I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: MAI ZAAMIN E CHAADAR THA, MUHAAFIZ THA HARAM KA\nAB ZINDA BHI REH JAAU TO KYA FAAYDAA AQA\nZAINAB KO BATA DENA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: I WAS THE GUARDIAN OF THE VEIL, AND PROTECTOR OF THE HOUSEHOLD,\nWHAT IS THE POINT IF I EVEN STAY ALIVE NOW,\nPLEASE DO TELL ZAINAB THAT I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: GODI MAI SAKINA KO UTHAUGA MAI KAISE\nKIS TARAH NIBHAUGA GHULAAMI KE TARIKE\nYE KAM TO NAHI SADMA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: HOW WILL I CARRY SAKINA IN MY ARMS,\nIN THIS CONDITION HOW WILL I BE A GOOD SERVANT TO YOU,\nIS THIS NOT ENOUGH PAIN THAT I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: JAB ZEEL SE ZAMIN KI TARAF AANE LAGA MAULA\nNA KOI MADADGAAR THA, NA KOI SAHARA\nUS WAQT KHYAL AYA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: WHEN HAZRAT ABBAS (A.S.) WAS FALLING FROM HIS HORSE,\nHE HAD NO HELPER NOR ANY SUPPORT,\nAT THAT TIME HE REALISED THAT HE DID NOT HAVE ANY HANDS

arabic text: BHAARI HAI ALAM TUM NA UTHAO ISE MAULA\nTUTI HAI QAMAR DEKHIYE TANHA NA UTHAEGA\nAQA HU MAI SHARMUNDA, MERE HAATH NAHI HAI
english translation text: THE ALAM (FLAG) IS VERY HEAVY AND YOUR BACK IS BROKEN, PLEASE DO NOT CARRY THE ALAM ALONE,\nMY MASTER I AM EMBARRASSED, I DO NOT HAVE ANY HANDS
